questions.question: Fill in the blank: "She was born ___ 1999."
questions.explanation: A year takes the preposition "in".

questions.question: Fill in the blank: "The meeting is ___ Monday."
questions.explanation: A day of the week takes "on".

questions.question: Fill in the blank: "I wake up ___ 6 a.m."
questions.explanation: A clock time takes "at".

questions.question: Fill in the blank: "He is good ___ Mathematics."
questions.explanation: The adjective "good" is followed by "at" when we speak of a skill.

questions.question: Fill in the blank: "She is afraid ___ dogs."
questions.explanation: "Afraid" takes the preposition "of".

questions.question: Fill in the blank: "He sat ___ the chair."
questions.explanation: A surface such as a chair takes "on".

questions.question: Fill in the blank: "India is rich ___ natural resources."
questions.explanation: "Rich in" is the fixed pair used for resources.

questions.question: Fill in the blank: "He is fond ___ music."
questions.explanation: "Fond" is followed by "of".

questions.question: Fill in the blank: "She is married ___ a doctor."
questions.explanation: "Married to" is the standard pair.

questions.question: Fill in the blank: "He was accused ___ theft."
questions.explanation: "Accused of" is the standard pair.

questions.question: Fill in the blank: "We arrived ___ Delhi yesterday."
questions.explanation: For cities and countries, "arrive in" is used.

questions.question: Fill in the blank: "He died ___ a road accident."
questions.explanation: "Died in an accident" is the standard expression (died of a disease).

questions.question: Fill in the blank: "She has been working here ___ 2018."
questions.explanation: "Since" is used with a starting point of time.

questions.question: Fill in the blank: "She has been working here ___ five years."
questions.explanation: "For" is used with a length of time.

questions.question: Fill in the blank: "The teacher divided the sweets ___ the two children."
questions.explanation: For two persons, "between" is used.

questions.question: Fill in the blank: "The sweets were distributed ___ the five children."
questions.explanation: For more than two, "among" is used.

questions.question: Fill in the blank: "He is senior ___ me."
questions.explanation: "Senior" and "junior" are followed by "to", not "than".

questions.question: Fill in the blank: "I prefer tea ___ coffee."
questions.explanation: "Prefer X to Y" is the correct construction.

questions.question: Fill in the blank: "He insisted ___ paying the bill."
questions.explanation: "Insist on" is the fixed pair.

questions.question: Fill in the blank: "She is angry ___ me for being late."
questions.explanation: We are angry "with" a person and "at" a thing or event.
